notes.title: Update for next demo.
notes.notes:
Added new rare cards
[olist]
Turret added (targets the nearest ship)

Triple Shot (adds two more bullets to each shot)

Teleport (Teleports to where the mouse is aiming)

Ricochet (Ricochets some bullets for 5 levels)

Repair + (Now this card restores 60HP to the ship)
[/olist]
Graphical overhaul of some enemies

Now general ships have updated graphics, except for the blue ship, the boss, and the kamikaze.

Player graphical overhaul

I believed the player had a good shape, but the colors felt dull; now it’s more vibrant than ever.

This also includes the support drones.

Graphical improvement of menu buttons and text

When I built the game, the buttons seemed fine but amateur; after some time studying, I improved them.

Black hole bug fix

The current bug consisted of the black hole card description having one line misaligned while the other was centered.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/dde962ed201705ee46d0b3ae1904fbb52156f3e2.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/24f7b1a085e51728970daa783efa8d30812309ad.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/dde962ed201705ee46d0b3ae1904fbb52156f3e2.gif"]

Finally, thank you for your patience! The game will have A NEW DEMO at the end of this month. And not only that: now that several personal and professional matters are resolved, we have a new release date for the official launch: October 6th.

Thank you to everyone who is excited and to those who want to give the game a chance. I’m working as hard as I can to finish it and meet your expectations.
